stepTitle: A straightforward method of finding the density of an object is to measure its mass and then measure its volume by submerging it in a graduated cylinder. What is the density of a $$240\, \text{g}$$ rock that displaces $$89.0\,\text{cm}**3$$ of water? Give the density to two significant figures (in $$\text{g/cm}**3)$$.
